title: Homogeneous section-normalized cochain tensor reindexing
statement: Fix a prime l, schemes X,Y, a scheme isomorphism g:X≅Y, native locally finite adic realizations R,S, and B:RingReindex(l,X,g,R,S) [def-sf-native-adic-reindexing-data]. There exists a natural isomorphism from totalTensor_Y followed by the cochain functor induced by modulePull to the product of that cochain functor followed by totalTensor_X. Its map on every homogeneous pure tensor section is the same pair of sections at the reindexed pro-etale object, namely reindexTensorPure [def-sf-native-adic-tensor-reindexing]. This asserts neither a derived comparison nor K-flat preservation nor a unit comparison.

proof.text: Obtain the ordinary natural tensor comparison with its normalized pure-section formula. Use the proved cochainModulesPreadditive theorem for bilinearity of the ordinary sheaf tensor.

Apply tensorPullbackTotal to the inverse ordinary comparison. Its naturality checks the total differential, including the integer sign. The ordinary comparison is invertible and module restriction is a left adjoint along this site equivalence; tensorPullbackTotal_isIso therefore makes the total chain map invertible. Naturality in both complexes gives a natural isomorphism; take its inverse.

The ι_mapBifunctorDesc equation computes the chain map on each total summand. Cancel its inverse to obtain the forward comparison on the reindexed summand. Evaluate on a pure sheaf section and apply the ordinary normalized formula. This is exactly coefficientTensorGenerator and reindexTensorPure.

source.place: BS Remark 6.8.15; Stacks Project Tags 03EK, 06YN; explicit ordinary/cochain subargument of lem-sf-adic-tensor-reindexing-models.

theorem exists_cochain_tensor_reindexing {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ≅ Y)
    (R : LocallyFiniteAdicRealization.Realization l X)
    (S : LocallyFiniteAdicRealization.Realization l Y) (B : RingReindex l X g.hom R S) :
    ∃ chain : coefficientTotalTensor.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology Y) (ring l Y S) ⋙
        (modulePull l X g.hom B).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      (((modulePull l X g.hom B).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod
        ((modulePull l X g.hom B).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) ⋙
        coefficientTotalTensor.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R),
      reindexTensorPure l X g.hom B chain
